name: dev.ucp.shopping.policy.return
title: Return Policy Extension
description: Defines the `dev.ucp.shopping.policy.return` policy type on the core `policies[]` primitive, enabling businesses to advertise return terms across one or more supported capabilities (catalog, cart, checkout, and order).

eligibility.description: Structured return eligibility statement. Omitted means eligibility is not stated structurally, not that returns are unlimited or not accepted. When `type` is `not_accepted`, the covered items cannot be returned and `supported_resolutions`, `methods`, and `restocking_fee` MUST be omitted.

supported_resolutions.description: Return outcomes guaranteed for every eligible return, as an unordered set; not an exhaustive list. Well-known values: `original_payment_method`, `store_credit`, `gift_card`, `exchange`, `replacement`.

methods.description: Return channels guaranteed for every eligible return, each with its maximum logistics cost where stated; not an exhaustive list. Omit when channels are not stated structurally.

restocking_fee.description: Maximum refund deduction, applied regardless of return channel. Omitted means the fee is not stated structurally, not that none is charged; set `percentage_bps` to `0` to state that no restocking fee is charged. Provide `percentage_bps`, `amount`, or both; when both are present, each is a cap computed over the same returned quantity and the deduction never exceeds either (e.g., 15% up to $50 per unit).

return_eligibility.title: Return Eligibility
return_eligibility.description: An open return eligibility statement. `window` states a guaranteed minimum period after an anchor event and, once resolved, the instant it ends; expiration does not signal non-returnability. `unlimited` states no time restriction, not unconditional eligibility. `not_accepted` states that the covered items cannot be returned. Unknown types establish no eligibility inference; consumers may use the base policy's `description`.

type.description: Eligibility kind. Well-known values: `window`, `unlimited`, `not_accepted`. Unknown values establish no eligibility inference.

duration.description: Length of the return window after the `anchor` event, as an ISO 8601 duration with whole-number components greater than zero (e.g., `P30D` is 30 days, `PT30M` is 30 minutes, `P1M` is one month; `T` separates date units from time units, so `M` before it means months and after it minutes). It states the term for presentation; the Business resolves the deadline as `expires_at`.

anchor.description: Event the window is measured from. Well-known values: `purchased`, `fulfilled`, `delivered`.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 instant at which the window ends, resolved by the Business once the `anchor` event has occurred (e.g., on an order after delivery). When covered quantities reach the anchor at different times, it states the earliest of their deadlines. An otherwise eligible return requested no later than this instant is accepted.

restocking_fee.title: Restocking Fee
restocking_fee.description: A deduction from the refund, stated as a percentage, a flat amount per unit, or both.

percentage_bps.description: Restocking fee in basis points of the amount paid for the returned quantity, after item-level discounts and excluding tax, shipping, and other fees (e.g., `1500` = 15%). On catalog surfaces, where no amount has been paid, the basis is the covered product's price. `0` states that no restocking fee is charged.

amount.description: Restocking fee as a flat charge per returned unit of quantity, in ISO 4217 minor units, in the currency of the enclosing response (see the spec for catalog surfaces). At least 1; state no fee with `percentage_bps` of `0`.

display_text.description: Human-readable fee label, naming any condition under which the fee applies (e.g., '15% restocking fee on opened items').

fee.title: Return Method Fee
fee.description: Logistics cost of using a return channel. Open vocabulary.

type.description: Cost structure. Well-known values: `free`, `fixed_fee` (see `fixed_fee`), `customer_responsibility` (the buyer arranges and pays for return shipping; no maximum is stated). An unrecognized value states no cost.

display_text.description: Human-readable fee label, naming any condition under which the fee applies (e.g., 'Return shipping, free for defective items').

fixed_fee.title: Fixed Fee Return Method Fee
fixed_fee.description: Fixed logistics fee charged for a return channel.

amount.description: Maximum channel fee per return shipment, in ISO 4217 minor units, in the currency of the enclosing response (see the spec for catalog surfaces). Required when type is fixed_fee. At least 1; state a free channel with fee type `free`.

return_method.title: Return Method
return_method.description: A return channel and its logistics cost.

fee.description: Maximum logistics cost of using this channel. Omitted means the cost is not stated, not that the channel is free.

return_policy.title: Return Policy
return_policy.description: A return policy statement with type `dev.ucp.shopping.policy.return`.

policies_item.description: A `policies[]` entry; validates against `return_policy` when `type` is `dev.ucp.shopping.policy.return`.

dev.ucp.shopping.cart.title: Cart with Return Policy
dev.ucp.shopping.cart.description: Cart extended with return policy terms on `policies[]`.

dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.title: Checkout with Return Policy
dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.description: Checkout extended with return policy terms on `policies[]`.

dev.ucp.shopping.order.title: Order with Return Policy
dev.ucp.shopping.order.description: Order extended with return policy terms on `policies[]`.

dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search.description: Catalog search composition with return policy (extends dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search).

dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup.description: Catalog lookup composition with return policy (extends dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup).
